```{=html}
<div style="max-width:680px; padding: 1.5rem 0.5rem;">

<h2 style="margin-top:0.2rem;">Species Exposure Dashboard</h2>

<p style="font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.6;">
This dashboard tracks how much of each species' geographic range has been
exposed to <strong>extreme climate events</strong> — temperatures and
precipitation outside the historical baseline — using ERA5 reanalysis data
from 1940 to the present.
</p>

<hr style="margin: 1.2rem 0;">

<h4>What you can explore</h4>
<ul style="line-height:1.8;">
  <li>
    <strong>Species Explorer</strong> — select any species to view its
    historical exposure time series, a polar summary of which climate
    variables have affected it most, and a map of its geographic range.
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>Hotspot Explorer</strong> — click any grid cell on the global
    map to see all species present there and how many are currently
    exposed to extreme conditions.
  </li>
</ul>

<hr style="margin: 1.2rem 0;">

<h4>Climate variables tracked</h4>
<p>Eight ERA5-derived extremes, covering both tails of temperature and
precipitation at annual and seasonal timescales:</p>
<ul style="line-height:1.8; columns:2; column-gap:2rem;">
  <li>High temperature (annual)</li>
  <li>Low temperature (annual)</li>
  <li>High temperature (warmest 3 months)</li>
  <li>Low temperature (coldest 3 months)</li>
  <li>High precipitation (annual)</li>
  <li>Low precipitation (annual)</li>
  <li>High precipitation (wettest 3 months)</li>
  <li>Low precipitation (driest 3 months)</li>
</ul>

<hr style="margin: 1.2rem 0;">

<h4>Data sources</h4>
<ul style="line-height:1.8;">
  <li><a href="https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/dataset/ecmwf-reanalysis-v5" target="_blank">ERA5 reanalysis</a> (ECMWF) — climate variables on a 0.25° global grid</li>
  <li><a href="https://www.iucnredlist.org/" target="_blank">IUCN Red List</a> — species range polygons and conservation status</li>
</ul>

<hr style="margin: 1.2rem 0;">

<h4>Run locally with custom filtering</h4>

  For more flexible filtering and custom data exploration, you can download and
  run the full interactive Shiny app from
  <a href="https://github.com/SpeciesExposure/exposureApp" target="_blank">github.com/SpeciesExposure/exposureApp</a>.

</p>
```

# Species Explorer {.tabset}

## {.sidebar}

**Species Explorer**

Select a species to see how much of its
range has been exposed to extreme climate events through time.


::: {.cell}

:::


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_species = {
  // Load Tom Select CSS once (can't use require() for CSS)
  if (!document.querySelector('link[href*="tom-select"]')) {
    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
    link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.4.3/dist/css/tom-select.bootstrap5.min.css';
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }
  // OJS require() wraps CommonJS exports as { default: ... }
  const TomSelectModule = await require("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.4.3/dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js");
  const TomSelect = TomSelectModule.default ?? TomSelectModule;

  // Map species → order using metadata; fall back to "Unknown"
  const metaRows = transpose(species_meta_data);
  const orderMap = new Map(metaRows.map(r => [r.Species, r.Order ?? "Unknown"]));

  // Group species (from authoritative list) by order
  const byOrder = new Map();
  for (const sp of species_list) {
    const order = orderMap.get(sp) ?? "Unknown";
    if (!byOrder.has(order)) byOrder.set(order, []);
    byOrder.get(order).push(sp);
  }

  // Build native <select> with <optgroup> per order
  const sel = document.createElement('select');
  for (const order of [...byOrder.keys()].sort()) {
    const grp = document.createElement('optgroup');
    grp.label = order;
    for (const sp of byOrder.get(order).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = sp;
      opt.textContent = sp.replace(/_/g, ' ');
      grp.appendChild(opt);
    }
    sel.appendChild(grp);
  }
  sel.value = species_list[0];

  // Wrapper that OJS viewof reads .value from and listens to for input events
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  Object.defineProperty(wrapper, 'value', { get: () => sel.value });
  const lbl = document.createElement('label');
  lbl.textContent = 'Species';
  lbl.style.cssText = 'display:block;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px;color:#495057;';
  wrapper.appendChild(lbl);
  wrapper.appendChild(sel);
  yield wrapper;

  const ts = new TomSelect(sel, {
    maxOptions: 150,
    placeholder: 'Type to search…',
    dropdownParent: 'body',
    onChange: () => wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
  });

  invalidation.then(() => ts.destroy());
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Reusable factory for the 2 (families) x 3 (aggregations) panel-selection
// checkbox grid. Returns a DOM element that satisfies the viewof contract
// (exposes `.value` as the array of selected slug strings and dispatches
// `input` events on change).
makePanelCheckboxGrid = function({ defaults = [], label = "Figures" } = {}) {
  const rows = transpose(panel_matrix);
  const families = ["Temperature", "Precipitation"];
  const aggs     = ["Seasonal max", "Annual", "Seasonal min"];
  const defaultSet = new Set(defaults);

  const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
  const lbl = document.createElement("label");
  lbl.textContent = label;
  lbl.style.cssText = "display:block;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:8px 0 4px;color:#495057;";
  wrapper.appendChild(lbl);

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.className = "panel-checkbox-grid";

  // Header row
  const thead = document.createElement("thead");
  const hr = document.createElement("tr");
  hr.appendChild(document.createElement("th"));
  for (const a of aggs) {
    const th = document.createElement("th");
    th.textContent = a;
    hr.appendChild(th);
  }
  thead.appendChild(hr);
  table.appendChild(thead);

  // Body rows
  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  const checkboxes = [];
  for (const fam of families) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    const rh = document.createElement("th");
    rh.scope = "row";
    rh.textContent = fam;
    tr.appendChild(rh);
    for (const a of aggs) {
      const td = document.createElement("td");
      td.setAttribute("data-agg", a);
      const cell = rows.find(r => r.family === fam && r.agg === a);
      if (cell) {
        const cb = document.createElement("input");
        cb.type = "checkbox";
        cb.value = cell.slug;
        cb.checked = defaultSet.has(cell.slug);
        cb.setAttribute("aria-label", `${fam} ${a}`);
        td.appendChild(cb);
        checkboxes.push(cb);
      }
      tr.appendChild(td);
    }
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  }
  table.appendChild(tbody);
  wrapper.appendChild(table);

  Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => checkboxes.filter(c => c.checked).map(c => c.value)
  });
  for (const cb of checkboxes) {
    cb.addEventListener("change", () => {
      wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    });
  }
  return wrapper;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_panels = makePanelCheckboxGrid({
  defaults: ["temperature__annual"],
  label: "Figures"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const sp  = encodeURIComponent(selected_species);

  // Outer wrapper holds the image + expand button
  const outer = DOM.element("div");
  outer.style.cssText = "position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;";

  const img = DOM.element("img");
  img.src = `data/species_figs/${sp}_polar.png`;
  img.style.cssText = "max-width:100%;max-height:160px;object-fit:contain;display:block;";
  img.onerror = () => {
    const msg = DOM.element("p");
    msg.textContent = "Polar figure not yet built \u2014 run the build step.";
    msg.style.cssText = "color:#999;font-size:12px;text-align:center;margin-top:2em;";
    img.replaceWith(msg);
  };
  outer.appendChild(img);

  // Expand button — opens a modal lightbox with the full-size image
  const btn = DOM.element("button");
  btn.title = "Expand";
  btn.innerHTML = `<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 3 21 3 21 9"/><polyline points="9 21 3 21 3 15"/><line x1="21" y1="3" x2="14" y2="10"/><line x1="3" y1="21" x2="10" y2="14"/></svg>`;
  btn.style.cssText = "position:absolute;top:4px;right:4px;padding:3px 5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.88);border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;color:#555;z-index:10;";
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const overlay = DOM.element("div");
    overlay.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.78);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:zoom-out;";
    const panel = DOM.element("div");
    panel.style.cssText = "background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 6px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);cursor:default;";
    panel.addEventListener("click", e => e.stopPropagation());
    const full = DOM.element("img");
    full.src = img.src;
    full.style.cssText = "max-width:calc(90vw - 32px);max-height:calc(90vh - 32px);object-fit:contain;display:block;";
    panel.appendChild(full);
    overlay.appendChild(panel);
    const close = () => { if (document.body.contains(overlay)) document.body.removeChild(overlay); };
    overlay.addEventListener("click", close);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function esc(e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") { close(); document.removeEventListener("keydown", esc); }
    });
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  });
  outer.appendChild(btn);

  yield outer;
  // After two rAF ticks, measure the card and update the image max-height.
  await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
  const _card = outer.closest('.bslib-card');
  const _hdr  = _card?.querySelector('.card-header');
  const _availH = (_card?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 0)
                - (_hdr?.getBoundingClientRect().height  ?? 0);
  if (_availH > 20) img.style.maxHeight = _availH + 'px';
}
```

#### Range map {width="60%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
species_range_map = {
  // Outer wrapper: initial height is a fallback; a ResizeObserver resizes it
  // to fill the card body after yield (.observablehq parent has no height).
  const outer = DOM.element("div");
  outer.style.cssText = "width:100%;height:280px;";
  const container = DOM.element("div");
  container.style.cssText = "width:100%;height:100%;";
  outer.appendChild(container);
  yield outer;

  // Size outer to fill the card body (wait two rAF ticks for layout to settle)
  await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
  const _card = outer.closest('.bslib-card');
  const _hdr  = _card?.querySelector('.card-header');
  const _availH = (_card?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 0)
                - (_hdr?.getBoundingClientRect().height  ?? 0);
  if (_availH > 50) outer.style.height = _availH + 'px';

  let map = null;

  // IUCN terms of use prohibit redistribution of reptile and amphibian range data.
  const RESTRICTED_ORDERS = new Set([
    "SQUAMATA","TESTUDINES","CROCODYLIA","RHYNCHOCEPHALIA", // reptiles
    "ANURA","CAUDATA","GYMNOPHIONA"                         // amphibians
  ]);
  const spMeta = transpose(species_meta_data).filter(row => row.Species === selected_species)[0];
  if (RESTRICTED_ORDERS.has(spMeta?.Order)) {
    const msg = DOM.element("p");
    msg.innerHTML = `Sorry, the IUCN data use agreement does not permit showing the range of this species &mdash; see <a href="https://www.iucnredlist.org/terms/terms-of-use" target="_blank" rel="noopener">IUCN terms of use (§ No Reposting or Redistribution)</a>.`;
    msg.style.cssText = "color:#666;font-size:13px;text-align:center;margin-top:3em;padding:0 1.5em;line-height:1.5;";
    container.appendChild(msg);
    return;
  }

  // Use the Leaflet already loaded by the R leaflet package (site_libs/leaflet-1.3.1).
  // Loading a separate CDN copy would overwrite window.L and break the Hotspot
  // Explorer's addProviderTiles call.
  const L = window.L;

  const sp = encodeURIComponent(selected_species);
  let mapData;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`data/species_maps/${sp}_map.json`);
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}`);
    mapData = await resp.json();
  } catch(e) {
    const msg = DOM.element("p");
    msg.textContent = "Range map not yet built \u2014 run the build step.";
    msg.style.cssText = "color:#999;font-size:12px;text-align:center;margin-top:2em;";
    container.appendChild(msg);
    return;
  }

  map = L.map(container, { preferCanvas: true });
  L.tileLayer("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Dark_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
    attribution: "Tiles &copy; Esri &mdash; Esri, DeLorme, NAVTEQ",
    maxZoom: 19
  }).addTo(map);

  const renderer = L.canvas({ padding: 0.5 });
  const bounds = [];

  // Colour: 1 variable = blue, 8 variables = red
  const varColor = (v) => {
    const t = Math.min((v - 1) / 7, 1);
    const r = Math.round(t * 215 + (1 - t) * 49);
    const g = Math.round((1 - t) * 115);
    const b = Math.round((1 - t) * 178 + t * 39);
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
  };

  for (const [c, v] of mapData) {
    const col = (c - 1) % rast_ncols + 1;
    const row = Math.floor((c - 1) / rast_ncols) + 1;
    const lon = rast_xmin + (col - 0.5) * rast_xres;
    const lat = rast_ymax - (row - 0.5) * rast_yres;
    const half_x = rast_xres / 2;
    const half_y = rast_yres / 2;
    L.rectangle(
      [[lat - half_y, lon - half_x], [lat + half_y, lon + half_x]],
      { fillColor: varColor(v), color: "none", weight: 0, fillOpacity: 0.75, renderer }
    ).addTo(map);
    bounds.push([lat, lon]);
  }

  if (bounds.length)
    map.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(bounds), { padding: [10, 10], maxZoom: 5 });

  // Sync Leaflet to the resized container (height was set after map init)
  map.invalidateSize();

  // Add minimap using the same plugin bundled by the R leaflet package.
  if (!window.L?.Control?.MiniMap) {
    if (!document.querySelector('link[href*="Control.MiniMap"]')) {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'stylesheet';
      link.href = 'site_libs/leaflet-minimap-3.3.1/Control.MiniMap.min.css';
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    }
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = 'site_libs/leaflet-minimap-3.3.1/Control.MiniMap.min.js';
      s.onload = resolve; s.onerror = reject;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }
  new L.Control.MiniMap(
    L.tileLayer("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Dark_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", { maxZoom: 19 }),
    { toggleDisplay: true, position: "topright", minimized: false }
  ).addTo(map);

  invalidation.then(() => map.remove());
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const sp     = encodeURIComponent(selected_species);
  const panels = transpose(panel_matrix);
  const slugToLabel = new Map(panels.map(p => [p.slug, `${p.family} \u2014 ${p.agg}`]));

    stack.appendChild(msg);
  }

  // Lightbox helper (modal full-size image on click)
  const openLightbox = (src, alt) => {
    const overlay = DOM.element("div");
    overlay.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.78);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:zoom-out;padding:24px;";
    const big = DOM.element("img");
    big.src = src; big.alt = alt;
    big.style.cssText = "max-width:95vw;max-height:90vh;background:#fff;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);";
    overlay.appendChild(big);
    overlay.addEventListener("click", () => overlay.remove());
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  };

  for (const slug of selected_panels) {
    const figure = DOM.element("figure");
    figure.style.cssText = "margin:0;width:100%;";

    const img = DOM.element("img");
    const src = `data/species_figs/${sp}__${slug}.png`;
    img.src = src;
    img.alt = `${selected_species.replace(/_/g, " ")} \u2014 ${slugToLabel.get(slug) ?? slug}`;
    img.title = "Click to enlarge";
    img.style.cssText = "max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto;cursor:zoom-in;";
    img.onerror = () => {
      const msg = DOM.element("p");
      msg.textContent = `No figure built for ${slugToLabel.get(slug) ?? slug}.`;
      msg.style.cssText = "color:#999;font-size:12px;text-align:center;margin:1em 0;";
      img.replaceWith(msg);
    };
    img.addEventListener("click", () => openLightbox(src, img.alt));

    figure.appendChild(img);
    stack.appendChild(figure);
  }

  const cap = DOM.element("div");
  cap.style.cssText = "flex:0 0 auto;font-size:0.78rem;line-height:1.55;color:#444;padding:0.6rem 1rem 0.4rem;border-top:1px solid #dee2e6;margin-top:4px;";
  cap.innerHTML = `<strong>Figure.</strong>
Per-cell climate exposure across the geographic range of the selected species, 1941\u20132025.
Each selected panel shows one ERA5-derived variable (temperature or precipitation) at one temporal aggregation (annual or warmest/coldest 3-month season).
<strong>Left sub-panel \u2014 Value \u00d7 time heatmap.</strong>
Year (x-axis) vs. the per-cell variable value (y-axis); tile fill encodes the percentile of that value under the historical empirical CDF (1941\u20132022), pooled across all range cells.
Translucent lines trace year-to-year trajectories for a random subsample of range cells; segments are coloured when the cell\u2019s value exceeds the species-level upper threshold (99th-of-99th-percentiles) or falls below the lower threshold (1st-of-1st-percentiles).
Dashed horizontal lines mark these thresholds.
<strong>Right sub-panel \u2014 Kernel density estimates.</strong>
Normalized KDEs of the variable, pooled across range cells, for the historical baseline period (grey) and the most recent year (purple); vertical dashed lines repeat the exposure thresholds.`;
  wrapper.appendChild(cap);

  return wrapper;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Listen for leaflet_mapclick events dispatched by the onRender handler.
// Converts lat/lng to a terra cell index (row-major, 1-indexed).
clicked_cell = Generators.observe(notify => {
  function handler(e) {
    const { lat, lng } = e.detail;
    if (lng < rast_xmin || lng > (rast_xmin + rast_ncols * rast_xres) ||
        lat > rast_ymax || lat <= (rast_ymax - rast_nrows * rast_yres)) {
      return; // outside raster extent — ignore
    }
    const col  = Math.floor((lng - rast_xmin) / rast_xres) + 1;
    const row  = Math.floor((rast_ymax - lat)  / rast_yres) + 1;
    const cell = (row - 1) * rast_ncols + col;
    notify(String(cell));
  }
  window.addEventListener('leaflet_mapclick', handler);
  notify(""); // initial: nothing selected
  return () => window.removeEventListener('leaflet_mapclick', handler);
})
```

### Cell trend over time {height="240px"}



```{ojs}
//| output: false
cell_trend_filtered = {
  if (clicked_cell === "") return [];
  const raw = transpose(cell_trend_data)
    .filter(d => d.cell === Number(clicked_cell))
    .filter(d => hotspot_vars.includes(d.var));
  // Build lookup: "year|var" -> n_species_exposed
  const lookup = new Map(raw.map(d => [`${d.year}|${d.var}`, d.n_species_exposed]));
  // Cross-join recent years (>2010) × selected vars, filling missing with 0
  const allYears = years_list.map(Number).filter(y => y > 2010);
  const rows = [];
  for (const year of allYears) {
    for (const v of hotspot_vars) {
      rows.push({ year, var: v, n_species_exposed: lookup.get(`${year}|${v}`) ?? 0 });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}
```

```{ojs}
  const row = Math.floor((c - 1) / rast_ncols) + 1;
  const lonRaw = rast_xmin + (col - 0.5) * rast_xres;
  const latRaw = rast_ymax - (row - 0.5) * rast_yres;
  const lon = Math.abs(lonRaw).toFixed(2) + "\u00b0" + (lonRaw >= 0 ? "E" : "W");
  const lat = Math.abs(latRaw).toFixed(2) + "\u00b0" + (latRaw >= 0 ? "N" : "S");
  return `${lat}, ${lon}`;
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Fetch the species exposure JSON for the selected year lazily.
// Only the current year's compact file is loaded; others are fetched on demand.
cell_species = {
  const raw = await fetch(`data/cell_species/species_${hotspot_year}.json`).then(r => r.json());
  const [varCodes, redlistCodes, spAttrs] = await cell_species_lookups;
  return raw.map(d => ({
    cell:            d.c,
    spName:          d.s,
    var:             varCodes[d.v],
    propExposed:     d.p,
    redlistCategory: redlistCodes[d.r] ?? "—",
    orderName:       spAttrs[d.s]?.o   ?? "—",
    familyName:      spAttrs[d.s]?.f   ?? "—"
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cell_filtered = clicked_cell === ""
  ? []
  : Array.from(cell_species
      .filter(d => d.cell === Number(clicked_cell))
      .filter(d => hotspot_vars.includes(d.var))
      .filter(d => !hotspot_threatened_only || ["CR", "EN", "VU"].includes(d.redlistCategory))
      .reduce((bySpecies, row) => {
        const existing = bySpecies.get(row.spName);
        if (existing) {
          existing.variables.push(row.var);
          existing.maxPropExposed = Math.max(existing.maxPropExposed, row.propExposed ?? 0);
        } else {
          bySpecies.set(row.spName, {
            ...row,
            variables: [row.var],
            maxPropExposed: row.propExposed ?? 0
          });
        }
        return bySpecies;
      }, new Map())
      .values())
      .map(row => ({
        ...row,
        variables: hotspot_vars.filter(variable => row.variables.includes(variable)),
        propExposed: row.maxPropExposed
      }))
```
